messages:
emma_sales: Heads-up Atlas Security (prospect) wants a 3-week POC to validate SSO (Okta) + SCIM provisioning + strict tenant domain locking. Theyre asking for role mapping semantics, SCIM delta behavior, and audit retention for HIPAA. Can we scope and price?

ryan_se: TL;DR: SAML supported (IdP & SP flows). Console supports group->role mapping and staged canary rollouts. SCIM v2 with PATCH (delta) supported; full sync possible but heavier. Domain proofing via TXT and tenant-claim enforcement prevents cross-tenant email claims.

atlas_security: Security constraints: encrypted assertions mandatory, NameID must be persistent (not email), session idle timeout must be <=15m, and audit retention >=1yr. Also need SIEM export of provisioning events and admin actions.

jules_infosec: noted. We support signed+encrypted assertions; will exchange certs and SP metadata. Default cert rotation 90d, can document alternate rotation plan for enterprise. SIEM exports via S3 or syslog available on Dedicated/Private; Hosted supports S3 export as add-on.

marta_ops: Pricing snapshot: Hosted POC recommended for fast iteration (est $1.2k/week baseline, varies by token usage). Dedicated trial (3w) requires small reservation (~$3.5k one-time) for predictable latency and higher SCIM bursts. Private = custom quote (HSM/KMS + infra). Hosted audit logs default 90d; enterprise add-on for 1y. For HIPAA/BAA we recommend Dedicated or Private.

emma_sales: @atlas_security can you share expected DAU, typical weekly new users, and peak provisioning spike numbers? Also send Okta group export and SP metadata when ready.

atlas_security: DAU ~11k, onboarding ~2k/week, migration spikes up to 6k/day. HIPAA applies. We'll provide SP metadata + Okta CSV and IP allowlist today. Need to confirm SCIM rate limits and mapping examples.

ryan_se: SCIM guidance: Hosted default 600 reqs/min, Dedicated burst to 1200. Recommend PATCH for delta updates (far smaller payloads). Example PATCH we give customers:

```
PATCH /Users/7b9f4
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{ "op": "replace", "path": "emails[type eq \"work\"].value", "value": "riley@atlassec.com" }]
}
```

deploy-bot: INF-5333 created  reserve Dedicated test node (1x A10g equiv) for atlas-poc, 3-week window. assigned: eng-runtime.

jules_infosec: Action items: exchange certs for assertion encryption, confirm NameID = persistent, set tenant session idle timeout = 15m on test tenant, and provide SIEM export config.

marta_ops: I'll prepare a short POC SOW: week1 domain proofing + SAML smoke tests, week2 SCIM + RBAC mapping + canary, week3 migration spike and signoff. Also produce pricing sheet (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and BAA path.

emma_sales: Good. I'll send consolidated SOW and ask Atlas to upload SP metadata + Okta CSV. Target SOW to Atlas legal/infosec by EOD. :thumbsup:
